title: general
text:
general

Ava: Morning — anyone else hear the microwave do a weird 3-beep arpeggio just now? 🎶 Microwave's getting fancy.
Ben: That's the bagel setting, it's trying to be Mozart.
Chris: lol it's the 'sourdough adagio'
Dana: vote: start a microwave choir? 👍 for yes, 👎 for no
Eli: @Ava thanks for restocking the coffee filters yesterday — you're a hero :star:
kudos-bot: Eli received 1 kudos from Ava — Reason: coffee filters refill
Finn: choir > silence. Also can we add automatic solo performer's fee? :moneybag:
Ben: also, please don't set the timer to hurricane, we've had 2 smoke alarms this week :grimacing:
Ava: noted. I'm starting a tiny playlist for the breakroom. Suggestions? 'Beep Beep Symphony' accepted.
Dana: quick poll: playlist or silence? Playlist wins by default as long as it doesn't include polka.
Chris: if microwave starts harmonizing with the kettle it's officially a band.
Ava: @everyone tiny reminder — fridge labels are back on the bulletin board. Label your lunch or face the microwave musicians. :tomato:
